patterns.message: core is the pure layer and must have no I/O. Inject the adapter's result as a parameter instead of importing the adapter, or move this logic to app if it genuinely needs to orchestrate an adapter call.
core is the pure layer; app depends on core, not the reverse. If app needs this logic, keep it in core and have app import it — do not import app from core.
core is the pure layer and must not depend on the delivery layer. Move CLI-facing wiring or formatting into cli, not core.
main is the composition-root entry point; it depends on cli, and nothing depends on it. Whatever you need from main belongs in core already — this shouldn't be an import at all.
the logging library is constructed only in the composition root (cli/context.ts). core sees only the injected Log function from core/log.ts.
adapters may depend on core only. app composes adapters together, not the reverse — move this composition into app instead of importing it from an adapter.
adapters may depend on core only. cli's context module is the composition root that wires adapters together — depend on core here, and let cli reach into this adapter instead.
main is the composition-root entry point; it depends on cli, and nothing depends on it. An adapter has no legitimate reason to reach into main.
the logging library is constructed only in the composition root (cli/context.ts). An adapter that needs to narrate takes the injected Log function from core/log.ts instead.
app may depend on core and adapters only, not cli. cli calls into app, not the reverse — expose this from app and have the cli command handler call it.
main is the composition-root entry point; it depends on cli, and nothing depends on it. app has no legitimate reason to reach into main.
the logging library is constructed only in the composition root (cli/context.ts). app sees only the injected Log function from core/log.ts, exactly like every other effect.
main is the composition-root entry point; it depends on cli, and nothing depends on it. cli has no legitimate reason to reach into main.
main may depend on cli only, so it stays a thin composition-root entry point. Route this through cli/app.ts (or cli/context.ts for wiring adapters) instead of importing it directly here.
